acceptance_criteria: The real transcription integration availability gate discovers supported binaries through portable executable resolution rather than Homebrew-only paths.
Clipboard tests restore or isolate global navigator state across tests.
Path-shortening tests cover Linux, macOS, and non-/home roots without hardcoding one host layout as the only contract.
Motion and scheduler timing tests use deterministic observable completion or fake clocks instead of fragile wall-clock sleeps.
Focused portability tests pass against the implementation revision.

impact: Platform-specific gates can silently skip integration coverage, leaked browser globals can couple tests, host-shaped paths can hide portability regressions, and wall-clock polling can flake under load.
lead_verification_obligations: Revalidate any historical tracker path omitted from this corrected decisive set before restoring it.
Run one forthcoming single stable complete open-pull-request census before recording overlaps or assigning any implementation owner.
Require deterministic cross-platform and test-isolation coverage for each surviving finding.

partial_findings.summary: Activity-feed tests replace the shared navigator.clipboard surface and require explicit isolation and restoration proof.
Path-shortening tests center /home-shaped fixtures and do not prove equivalent behavior for other home-root layouts.
A CI-runnable chain test now exercises PATH-based ffmpeg resolution with a virtual executable.
The real integration test still decides availability through Homebrew-only absolute binary paths.
The browser-motion completion helper still polls with a real 16 ms timer inside a bounded wall-clock loop.
